item.title: Date confirmed for Mansfield Town v Arsenal
item.description: Mansfield Town’s Emirates FA Cup fifth round tie at home to Arsenal will be played at One Call Stadium on Saturday 07 March (12.15pm kick-off).The match will be shown live on TNT Sports 1 and discovery+ Ticket information will be announced in due course.

item.title: Team news: Stags v Lincoln
item.description: Nigel Clough makes five changes to the side that faced Blackpool in midweek. Kyle Knoyle, Aaron Lewis, Nathan Moriah-Welsh, Will Evans and Rhys Oates replace Luke Bolton, Jon Russell, Oliver Irow, Regan Hendry and Victor Adeboyejo in the team to take on Lincoln this afternoon. Tyler Roberts returns to the Mansfield bench after a lengthy absence with a calf injury. Louis Reed captains Stags at One Call Stadium. Starting XI: Roberts, Knoyle, Oshilaja, Blake-Tracy, Akins, Lewis, Reed ©️, McLaughlin

item.title: Report: Stags 0-2 Lincoln
item.description: Mansfield Town were defeated 2-0 at One Call Stadium this afternoon by an in-form Lincoln City side. Forward Rob Street scored for the second time this week to give his side the lead from the penalty spot, before midfielder Tom Bayliss turned home a close-range shot in the dying moments to seal the points for the Imps. item.title: Ticket information: Mansfield Town v Arsenal
item.description: Mansfield Town are pleased to confirm ticket information for the club’s Emirates FA Cup fifth round fixture at home to Arsenal. The tie will take place at One Call Stadium on Saturday 07 March (12.15pm kick-off). Season ticket holders will have priority access to purchase tickets from 6pm on Tuesday 24 February until 5pm on Friday 27 February.
